canonical_title: Legal and Ethical Responsibilities in Assessment
aliases: Legal and ethical responsibilities associated with assessment activity

one_line_answer.text: Assessors must be aware of the legal and ethical responsibilities of assessment. Candidates must be informed of them.

cites.quote: Assessors must be aware and candidates must be informed of the legal and ethical

keywords.bn: প্রতিষ্ঠানের মান রক্ষার নিয়ম ও পদ্ধতি

bangla_explanation: Assessment শুরুর আগে assessor আর candidate দুজনকেই legal ও ethical দায়িত্ব জানতে হবে।
চারটি দায়িত্ব: OSH মানা, ফলাফল confidential রাখা, full consent নেওয়া, workplace-এর quality systems মানা।
Candidate-এর অনুমতি ছাড়া তার কোনো তথ্য অন্য কাউকে বলা যাবে না।
Trainee-কে appeal করার অধিকার আর পদ্ধতি জানাতে হবে।

example.en: At a welding training centre, the assessor explains hazards and the test purpose. The trainee then signs the self assessment form.
example.bn: ওয়েল্ডিং সেন্টারে assessor আগে hazard আর উদ্দেশ্য বুঝিয়ে দেন, তারপর trainee form-এ সই করে consent দেয়।

mnemonic.text: O-C-F-Q: OSH, Confidentiality, Full consent, Quality systems

items.text: Occupational health and safety requirements: inform everyone about the work and its potential hazards.

cites.quote: it is important to inform everyone about the nature of the work and the potential hazards

items.text: Confidentiality of assessment outcomes: nothing is divulged without the candidate's prior consent.

cites.quote: Nothing can be divulged to other persons or organizations/entities without prior consent of the candidate.

items.text: Full consent of candidates: confirmed with the signing of the self assessment form.

cites.quote: This is confirmed with the signing of the self assessment form by the candidates.

items.text: Adherence to quality systems, policies and procedures of the workplace.

cites.quote: Adherence to quality systems, policies and procedures of the workplace.

traps.text: Confidentiality is the responsibility of both the assessor and the candidate.

cites.quote: This is both the responsibility of the assessor and the candidate.

traps.text: Consent comes after the candidate has understood the purpose and procedures.

cites.quote: the full consent of the candidates after having understood all the context, purpose, procedures

traps.text: The assessment must not hinder the systems of the workplace.

cites.quote: The assessment activity shall in no way hinder the systems observed in the work place

short.prompt: What are an assessor's legal and ethical responsibilities in assessment?
short.modelAnswer:
Assessors must be aware, and candidates must be informed, of these responsibilities:
1. Occupational health and safety (OSH) requirements: explain hazards.
2. Confidentiality of assessment outcomes: share nothing without the candidate's consent.
3. Full consent of candidates: they sign the self assessment form.
4. Adherence to quality systems, policies and procedures of the workplace.
Also tell the trainee about the right to appeal.

keyPoints.text: Keeping the assessment confidential preserves its integrity and dignity.

cites.quote: Keeping the assessment procedure confidential will preserve the integrity and dignity of the assessment

keyPoints.text: Trainees must have access to an appeal process. Make the trainee aware of this right.

cites.quote: It is essential that trainees have access to a process for appealing against an assessment decision.
You must make the trainee aware of this right and how to access it if necessary.

keyPoints.text: The candidate will be informed of the result. The assessor makes the feedback.

cites.quote: Whatever is the result of the assessment, the candidate will be informed of it
The assessor makes the feedback to the candidate.

checks.note: CBLM 12 p.15 lists 4 bulleted responsibilities, then numbered '1. Transparent reporting and recording of assessment process' and '2. Appeal Process'. It is unclear whether 1-2 belong to the same list. Card keeps the 4 bullets and puts appeal and result reporting in key points.
paper-short-questions-q62 answer guide adds 'identify and responsibly manage conflicts of interest'. Conflict of interest is not in the CBLM 12 evidence pack, so the card does not teach it.
